rationale: Wind-caused structural damage to the policyholder's own roof is clearly property damage to the dwelling.
claim_summary: Wind damage claim: four shingles blown from back porch roof overhang following last weekend's wind. No interior water damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Policyholder has $2,500 deductible; repair cost is below deductible threshold.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off roof, no interior water damage
